_README: Per-project pixel-parity config, consumed by orchestration/probes/pixel.sh. hideSelectors are applied to BOTH sides (reference + local) before the screenshot: third-party widgets the migration will never reproduce (Chatbase chat bubble) and symmetric floating chrome. pageOverrides relax the threshold for pages whose STATIC reference cannot show client-rendered listing cards (SXA search results render empty in the crawl DOM, while the migrated page correctly shows articles - a structural reference limitation, not a fidelity defect; those pages are covered by the structural fidelity + content gates instead).
